>
[Minotaur Weapon Familiarity](/Feats.aspx?ID=5367) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

</column>

---

Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields. You have familiarity with the [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=371), [falchion](/Weapons.aspx?ID=373), [glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=375), and [greataxe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=376)—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these martial weapons as simple weapons.

 At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its [critical specialization effect](/Rules.aspx?ID=235).
name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity
